question: What is the project code name used internally?
why: Used everywhere in place of customer or product names

question: In one paragraph, what is the deliverable (what gets built and handed over)?
What problem does it solve for the end user?
What stage is the project in (concept, design, prototype, qualification, production, sustaining)?
What are the next three milestones and their target dates?
What is the overall delivery or completion date?
How many units (or machines) are to be built, and over what period?
Is this a new design, a modification of an existing product, or a build to a customer design?
What existing products or earlier versions does it replace or resemble?
What are the three biggest technical risks the team sees today?
What are the three biggest schedule risks?
What has already been decided that should not be revisited?
What is still undecided that blocks progress?
What document defines the requirements (specification, statement of work, purchase order), with number and revision?
Which standards are called out, with their exact editions?
What deliverables besides hardware are required (reports, data items, manuals, drawings, certificates)?
Which design reviews or customer reviews are required, and when?
Which tests must the customer witness?
What acceptance criteria does the customer use to accept the product?
Who is the customer contact for technical questions, and for quality questions (role, not name)?
Are there penalties or incentives tied to dates or performance?
What has the customer said informally that is not yet in the written requirements?
Who is on the team, by role (project lead, mechanical, electrical, controls, quality, purchasing, test)?
Who has authority to approve design changes?
What is the budget, and how much is spent or committed so far?
Which parts or services are long-lead, and what are their quoted lead times?
Which suppliers are already chosen, and for what?
Which items are single-source?
Which outside labs or contractors are involved, and for what?
Which quality system does the company work under (AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, other)?
Where do controlled documents live (system name), and how are revisions released?
How are engineering changes requested and approved?
Is first article inspection required, and to what standard (for example AS9102)?
How are nonconformances recorded and dispositioned?
Are there customer flow-down clauses on suppliers (quality, counterfeit parts)?
What records must be kept, and for how long?
Which MIL-STD-810 methods and levels are required, in writing?
Is an IP rating required? Which?
Immersion: depth, duration, temperature differential, and with cables disconnected or connected?
Washdown: jet type, pressure, temperature?
Operating and storage temperature ranges?
Solar loading and desert conditions?
Sand and dust, salt fog, humidity, rain?
Shock, drop and vibration levels?
Mounting location and method in use (vehicle, stand, carried)?
What has the customer said informally about washdown or water that is not yet written?
Board operating temperature range per its maker?
Humidity rating (non-condensing?)
Board dimensions, mounting holes and heat dissipation?
Is it powered from the measured line? Voltage range and measurement category?
Voltage inputs: number, rating, connector type today?
Current sensor inputs: number, signal type (mV, Rogowski, Hall), connector type today?
Analog inputs: number and ranges?
Communications: USB, Ethernet, Wi-Fi (antenna internal or external)?
Internal battery? Type, charging, replacement?
Display, LEDs or buttons that must be visible or usable?
Current housing material and flammability rating?
Current approvals (safety listing, measurement category, EMC, FCC/CE)?
Who owns the board design, firmware and accuracy calibration?
Must the military version keep the safety approval? Who re-evaluates it?
Is EMC or MIL-STD-461 testing required?
Enclosure chosen (material, size, rating as sold)?
Every opening added, and how each is sealed?
Connector family for voltage inputs, rated for the voltage and category?
Connector family for current and analog inputs?
Sealed USB and Ethernet connectors?
Antenna solution for Wi-Fi?
Sealing caps for unmated connectors, on lanyards?
Panel seals and torque values?
Vent membrane? Rated depth?
Desiccant or conformal coating?
Board mounting inside the enclosure?
Internal heater or thermal measures for cold and heat?
Early leak test method on modified enclosures?
Environmental lab chosen and dates?
Test sequence and number of units?
Functional and accuracy checks before and after each test, and whose procedure?
Production leak test (pressure decay) planned?
